b2-10-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Have Them Do
b2-10-01.scenario: A visitor asks the old Latin teacher how he works with his pupils at the gymnasium. You are the teacher and answer.
b2-10-01.prompt: Tell the visitor what you have your pupils do.
cues: Say that you have your pupils write an essay every week
Say that you make them read old poems
b2-10-01.target: Minden héten esszét íratok a diákokkal, és régi verseket olvastatok velük.
b2-10-01.english: Every week I have the pupils write an essay, and I make them read old poems.
b2-10-01.canDo: I can form causative verbs using -at/-et and -tat/-tet according to syllable count and stem structure

b2-10-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Did It?
b2-10-02.scenario: Imre's friend asks how the translation was made for the self-study society. You are Imre Sátordy and answer.
b2-10-02.prompt: Tell your friend who the teacher had do what.
cues: Say that the teacher had you translate the poem
Say that he had your friends copy the original lines
b2-10-02.target: A tanár velem fordíttatta le a verset, és a barátaimmal másoltatta le az eredeti sorokat.
b2-10-02.english: The teacher had me translate the poem, and he had my friends copy the original lines.
b2-10-02.canDo: I can mark the intermediate agent (causee) with the instrumental suffix -val/-vel when a transitive verb is made causative

b2-10-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Question That Made Us Think
b2-10-03.scenario: After the class the old teacher asks Imre what the poem did to him. You are Imre Sátordy and answer.
b2-10-03.prompt: Tell the teacher what the poem and the teacher's lessons did to you and your classmates.
cues: Say that the poem made you think
Say that the teacher always makes the whole class work hard
b2-10-03.target: A vers elgondolkodtatott engem, és ön minket mindig megdolgoztat.
b2-10-03.english: The poem made me think, and you always make us work hard.
b2-10-03.canDo: I can distinguish intransitive causatives where the causee takes the accusative (-t) from transitive causatives where the causee takes -val/-vel

b2-10-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Taught or Had Taught
b2-10-04.scenario: A classmate asks Imre who teaches him and who pays for his schooling. You are Imre Sátordy and answer.
b2-10-04.prompt: Tell your classmate who teaches you and who has you educated.
cues: Say that your father pays for your schooling at this gymnasium
Say that the teacher teaches the class himself
b2-10-04.target: Az apám nagy áldozatok árán taníttat engem ebben a gimnáziumban. A tanár maga tanít minket.
b2-10-04.english: My father has me educated at this gymnasium at the cost of great sacrifices. The teacher teaches us himself.
b2-10-04.canDo: I can distinguish primary lexicalized causatives (tanít, épít, állít) from double/productive causatives (taníttat, építtet, állíttat)

b2-10-05.title: Communicative Challenge: My Old Teacher
b2-10-05.scenario: Years later a journalist asks Imre Sátordy about the old Latin teacher. You are Imre and answer.
b2-10-05.prompt: Tell the journalist what the teacher made you do and what he accustomed you to.
cues: Say that the teacher had you write essays
Say that he accustomed you to independence
b2-10-05.target: A tanár esszéket íratott velünk, és önállóságra szoktatott minket.
b2-10-05.english: The teacher had us write essays, and he accustomed us to independence.
b2-10-05.canDo: I can combine transitive (-val/-vel) and intransitive (-t) causative structures in reflective prose

b2-10-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Telling My Father
b2-10-consolidation.scenario: Imre writes to his father about his school. You are Imre Sátordy and answer his father's question about the school.
b2-10-consolidation.prompt: Tell your father what the teacher does with the class and thank him for the schooling.
cues: Say that the teacher has you write essays
Say that he makes every pupil think
Say that your father pays for your schooling
b2-10-consolidation.target: A tanár esszét íratott velünk, és mindenkit elgondolkodtatott. Te nagy áldozatok árán taníttatsz engem.
b2-10-consolidation.english: The teacher had us write an essay, and he made everyone think. You have me educated at the cost of great sacrifices.
b2-10-consolidation.canDo: I can form causative verbs with -at/-et and -tat/-tet across monosyllabic and polysyllabic stems
